Initial release of ffmpeg-merge-video – fast, flexible video merging via cloud FFmpeg.

- Combine multiple video clips into a single seamless file using easy prompts.
- Supports advanced workflows: concat demuxer, re-encoding, mixed-format inputs.
- Handles automatic API setup, token management, and session creation.
- Works with a wide variety of formats: mp4, mov, mkv, avi, webm, and more.
- Useful for editors, developers, and content creators — no GUI required.
